name: about-architecture
title: About Architecture Studio
description: A white studio about block with a giant 'Building Modernity.' headline, a short positioning note and two tall greyscale building photos set at different heights.
use: An architecture or design studio wants a restrained editorial about block led by type and photos.
avoid: Photos are hardcoded and the colour-on-hover reveal never happens on touch.
a11y: The colour-on-hover reveal is desktop only, and reduced motion is not honoured. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white page with a tiny spaced eyebrow above an enormous black headline, its second word set in italic. A narrow grey paragraph aligns right, above two tall greyscale skyscraper photos that sit at offset heights.
behaves: The eyebrow and headline slide in from the left as they enter view. Each photo stays greyscale until hovered, then slowly returns to full colour.
customise: Headline, paragraph, photo URLs and captions live in the JSX; grayscale timing and spacing are classes.
weight: light: Two photos and a couple of fade-ins once; no loop.
